notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.1.8

New
- Older E-Sys (3.30 and newer) works with E-Sys MAX: fault scan, module info, battery, clear faults, FA backup, FSC and SFA status, FDL editor names and search. We still recommend E-Sys 22.06 or newer (best 25.10).
- Old E-Sys that closed by itself at start now starts on a newer, checked Java 8 (E-Sys MAX gets it for you the first time).
- Send us a message: add a screenshot (Add picture, or Ctrl+V after Win+Shift+S). Pictures stay sharp.
- E-Sys 23.10 is now a tested version.

Fixed
- E-Sys 26.04: coding tools now open (before, they could stay on "Not ready yet").
- E-Sys 23.x: activating an FA no longer stops with an error, and the drop-downs keep working.
- E-Sys 23.10 installed over 23.04: Settings no longer stop with an error.
- E-Sys 22.10: times in the VO preview, FA, cheat sheets and file names use your own time zone.
- Coding on old E-Sys (3.36) in dark mode no longer stops with an error.
- CAFD editor: the "Values from ECU" box keeps room to type on small laptop screens, and the line above it can be dragged to make it taller.

Improved
- Messages moved to About > Send us a message (the unread count shows there).
- Licensed PCs: installing the Demo again brings back the full app by itself.
- Restart module and Clear faults wait a moment for the battery reading instead of asking you to try again.
- Safer updates and stronger protection of the app's files.
- Many smaller fixes.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
